context: Sakura, now a teacher, is at her own school's open house. Asuka comes by as guest.
purpose: two teachers — circle complete — adult professional warmth

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、立派なお教室。生徒さんも、明るいね。
lines.en: What a beautiful classroom, Sakura-san. Your students are so bright.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Slow opening — taking in the room. Voice soft and present, lingering on real approval. Not performative; the kind of warmth that comes from actually noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、先生。生徒たち、本当に可愛い。
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. They really are wonderful.
lines.style: Quiet pride with gratitude underneath. Soft, sincere — not bragging, just affirming what matters. Slight lift on the words about her students. Genuine warmth, no artifice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: こうやって、来てもらえて、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm really glad I could come see this.
lines.style: Slow, tender opening. Each phrase given weight. Quiet voice, eyes engaged. The relief and happiness of witnessing something real. Trailing softly into the moment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生がいてくれたから、ここまで、来れました。
lines.en: I wouldn't have made it here without you.
lines.style: Direct and quiet. Slight catch before speaking — vulnerability underneath gratitude. Held steady, not wavering. Simple, true words spoken as if they cost something to say.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: これからも、お互い、ね。応援してる。
lines.en: And I'll keep cheering you on from here.
lines.style: Soft promise. Not dramatic — just steady and clear. A slight pause before 'from here,' like extension into the future. Warm, closing embrace without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生徒たちにも、いつか、先生のこと、話します。
lines.en: One day I'll tell my students about you.
lines.style: Looking forward. Soft, almost thinking-out-loud. A quiet decision being made in real time. Gentle certainty — this moment matters and will carry forward.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ありがとう。さくらさんが、続けていってくれる、それが、嬉しい。
lines.en: That makes me happy. That you'll keep going.
lines.style: Receives the moment fully. Small pause after 'happy,' letting it land. Voice steady and clear, slightly thick with feeling but controlled. Not needing much — just witnessing and affirming the continuation.
